supplier.rationale: Maps general supplier inquiries to SEC 10-K disclosures regarding contract manufacturers and foundries.

customer.rationale: Captures customer concentration and downstream channel disclosures commonly used in 10-K Item 1.

competition.rationale: Aligns market competition queries with Item 1 business competition and Item 1A market risk disclosures.

risk.rationale: Expands risk-related queries to match formal risk-factor terminology used throughout Item 1A.

facility.rationale: Connects facility or infrastructure questions to physical property and operations disclosures.
